ycoss:739.long_description: Notable Labs is building a personalized drug discovery platform to identify treatment options for relapsed and refractory cancer patients — starting with blood cancer — to address the long tail of cancer treatment. We look at a person’s actual cancer cells, test combinations of FDA approved drugs, and see which combinations kill the cancer cells and leave the healthy cells alive. We focus on combinations because cancer is often difficult to target with just one drug and starting with a single drug can lead to resistant clones or relapse. We're building a highly automated lab in Foster City running on our custom software and are currently testing relapsed/refractory cancer patients as well as samples from a variety of pharma/biotech partnerships. https://www.notablelabs.com/careers
ycoss:739.metadata_document: Notable Labs is a Y Combinator company. It participated in the Winter 2015 batch, in 2015. Its status is public. Its stage is growth. Y Combinator lists its industry as Healthcare. Its sub-industry is Healthcare within Diagnostics. Additional listed industries: Diagnostics. Y Combinator source tags: Biotech, Drug discovery, Oncology. It is located in San Francisco, CA, USA; Foster City, CA, USA. Listed regions: United States of America, America / Canada, Remote, Partly Remote. Its team size is 40. Y Combinator lists it as a top company. It is currently hiring. It launched in 2014.
